```{r}
run_class_model <- function(
  class_name,
  species_list,
  dfo,
  all_cells,
  all_years,
  effort_matrix
) {
  y_3d <- prepara_dati_classe(
    dfo,
    species_list,
    all_cells,
    all_years,
    effort_matrix
  )

  # Standardizzazione covariate
  year_std <- as.vector(scale(all_years))
  effort_vec <- as.numeric(effort_matrix)
  effort_std <- matrix(scale(effort_vec), nrow = nrow(effort_matrix))

  # Preparazione covariata tin_1 (quota altimetrica)
  cells_in_y <- rownames(effort_matrix)
  tin_data <- dfo %>%
    select(cellcodeX, tin_1) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(cellcodeX = as.character(cellcodeX)) %>%
    filter(cellcodeX %in% cells_in_y) %>%
    group_by(cellcodeX) %>%
    summarise(tin_1 = mean(round(tin_1), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  tin_df <- data.frame(cellcodeX = cells_in_y) %>%
    left_join(tin_data, by = "cellcodeX")

  tin_std <- as.vector(scale(tin_df$tin_1))

  nim_data <- list(
    y = y_3d,
    effort = effort_std,
    year = year_std,
    tin_1 = tin_std
  )
  nim_constants <- list(
    n_species = length(species_list),
    n_sites = dim(y_3d)[2],
    n_years = dim(y_3d)[3]
  )

  code <- nimbleCode({
    # HYPER-PRIORS (Trend di Classe)
    mu_beta_year ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)
    sigma_beta_year ~ dunif(0, 5)
    mu_alpha_psi ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)
    sigma_alpha_psi ~ dunif(0, 5)
    mu_beta_tin ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)
    sigma_beta_tin ~ dunif(0, 5)

    # Priors fissi per detection
    alpha_p_mean ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)
    beta_effort ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)

    for (s in 1:n_species) {
      # Specie-specific coefficients (estratti dalla distribuzione di classe)
      beta_year_psi[s] ~ dnorm(mu_beta_year, sd = sigma_beta_year)
      alpha_psi[s] ~ dnorm(mu_alpha_psi, sd = sigma_alpha_psi)
      beta_tin_psi[s] ~ dnorm(mu_beta_tin, sd = sigma_beta_tin)
      alpha_p[s] ~ dnorm(alpha_p_mean, sd = 2)

      for (i in 1:n_sites) {
        for (t in 1:n_years) {
          # Occupancy (con effetto quota)
          logit(psi[s, i, t]) <- alpha_psi[s] +
            beta_year_psi[s] * year[t] +
            beta_tin_psi[s] * tin_1[i]
          z[s, i, t] ~ dbern(psi[s, i, t])
          # Detection
          logit(p[s, i, t]) <- alpha_p[s] + beta_effort * effort[i, t]
          y[s, i, t] ~ dbern(z[s, i, t] * p[s, i, t])
        }
      }
    }

    # Trend medio della classe (a quota media)
    for (t in 1:n_years) {
      class_trend[t] <- ilogit(mu_alpha_psi + mu_beta_year * year[t])
    }
  })

  z_init <- y_3d
  z_init[is.na(z_init)] <- 0
  inits <- list(
    mu_beta_year = 0,
    mu_alpha_psi = 0,
    mu_beta_tin = 0,
    sigma_beta_year = 1,
    sigma_alpha_psi = 1,
    sigma_beta_tin = 1,
    alpha_p_mean = 0,
    beta_effort = 0,
    z = z_init
  )

  # Esecuzione NIMBLE
  samples <- nimbleMCMC(
    code = code,
    constants = nim_constants,
    data = nim_data,
    inits = inits,
    monitors = c(
      "mu_beta_year",
      "mu_beta_tin",
      "class_trend",
      "sigma_beta_year",
      "sigma_beta_tin"
    ),
    niter = 20000,
    nburnin = 5000,
    nchains = 3,
    thin = 10,
    samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE
  )

  # 5. DIAGNOSTICHE E RISULTATI
  rhat_df <- as.data.frame(gelman.diag(samples, multivariate = FALSE)$psrf)

  class_trend_cols <- grep("class_trend", colnames(as.matrix(samples)))
  class_trend_samples <- as.matrix(samples)[, class_trend_cols]

  anni_num <- all_years

  df_plot <- data.frame(
    Anno = anni_num,
    Occupancy = colMeans(class_trend_samples),
    Lower = apply(class_trend_samples, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
    Upper = apply(class_trend_samples, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
  )

  # 6. PLOT E SALVATAGGIO
  pOccu <- df_plot |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Anno, y = Occupancy)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
      fill = "forestGreen",
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_line(color = "forestGreen", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "forestGreen", size = 3) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(
      title = class_name,
      subtitle = paste("R-hat:", round(mean(rhat_df[, 1]), 2)),
      x = '',
      y = "Occupancy (Class Trend)",
      caption = "nimble (hierarchical multi-species)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

  print(pOccu)

  ggsave(
    paste0('output_bayes/', class_name, '_', today(), '.pdf'),
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )

  # Salva risultati completi
  saveRDS(
    list(
      class = class_name,
      species_list = species_list,
      samples = samples,
      plot_data = df_plot,
      rhat = rhat_df
    ),
    paste0("output_bayes/class_", class_name, "_", today(), ".rds")
  )

  return(samples)
}
```
